executive.verdict: Well-structured but prototype-grade Spring Cloud microservices system. Keep the skeleton; re-engineer money movement, authorisation, secrets, delivery pipeline and operability.
headline: Architecture: sensible decomposition (gateway, channel services, core ledger, discovery, config, tracing) but synchronous non-atomic distributed writes and core exposed at the edge (TDD-ARC-01, TDD-ARC-02).
Security: 8 Critical findings incl. committed secrets, broken object/function-level authorisation, header-trust model, password logging, third-party config supply chain (TDD-SEC-*).
Data integrity: no amount validation, double-adjusted balances, no locking, no idempotency, mutable single-entry ledger (TDD-DAT-*).
Engineering maturity: no CI/CD, 18 unit tests in one service, no IaC/Kubernetes despite README claims (TDD-ENG-*, TDD-INF-*).
Stack currency: Spring Boot 3.2.4 / Spring Cloud 2023.0.0 and Keycloak 23 are past their open-source support windows per vendor policy (to be re-verified) (TDD-STK-01, STK-02).
Build/test results and dependency CVE scan could not be produced in the assessment environment (Maven Central HTTP 429) - limitation, not a code defect.
executive.recommendation: Reuse as accelerator. Phase 0 stabilisation (~4-6 weeks, ~3 engineers) closes all Critical items; Phase 1-2 (~6-8 months, 6-8 engineers) reaches bank-pilot readiness. Effort figures are indicative assessor estimates.

findings.title: Spring Boot 3.2.4 / Spring Cloud 2023.0.0 outside OSS support window
findings.description: All services pin Boot 3.2.4 and Cloud 2023.0.0.
findings.technical_impact: No upstream security patches without commercial support.
findings.business_impact: Exposure to unpatched CVEs; audit findings.
findings.remediation: Upgrade to a supported Boot 3.x/Cloud release train; add Renovate/Dependabot.

findings.title: Keycloak 23 server with 24.x admin client
findings.description: Server 23.0.7 runs in start-dev; admin client 24.0.4.
findings.remediation: Upgrade Keycloak (production mode) and align admin client.

findings.title: springdoc WebFlux UI starter used in Spring MVC services
findings.description: springdoc-openapi-starter-webflux-ui 2.1.0 declared in core, user, fund-transfer, utility (servlet apps).
findings.technical_impact: Swagger UI may not register; mixed reactive deps on classpath.
findings.remediation: Use springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui matching Boot version.

findings.title: Documented technologies not implemented
findings.description: README lists RabbitMQ, Prometheus, Kubernetes, Sleuth; none present in code (Sleuth replaced by Micrometer).
findings.remediation: Correct README; implement only if roadmap requires.

findings.title: Synchronous, non-atomic distributed write for payments
findings.description: Orchestrator saves PENDING, calls core via Feign, then saves SUCCESS; no saga, outbox or compensation.
findings.technical_impact: Partial failures leave channel and ledger inconsistent.
findings.remediation: Saga state machine + transactional outbox + idempotent ledger API + reconciliation job.

findings.title: Core ledger exposed through public gateway route
findings.description: Route /banking-core/** -> core-banking-service; gateway only requires authentication.
findings.technical_impact: Ledger API reachable from the internet.
findings.remediation: Remove route; internal network only; service-to-service auth.

findings.title: No authorisation tier between edge and services
findings.description: Gateway enforces 'authenticated'; downstream services have no Spring Security and trust X-Auth-Id.
findings.technical_impact: Every resource vulnerable to IDOR; zero-trust absent.
findings.remediation: Every service as OAuth2 resource server; entitlement/policy layer.

findings.title: Shared MySQL server and over-privileged shared DB user
findings.description: Four schemas on one instance; one app user with DDL+DML on *.*.
findings.technical_impact: Blast radius across services; no data-ownership enforcement.
findings.remediation: Per-service least-privilege users; separate ledger instance in prod.

findings.title: No asynchronous/event backbone
findings.description: No broker or domain events though README describes RabbitMQ notifications.
findings.technical_impact: Tight temporal coupling; no notification/audit stream.
findings.remediation: Introduce Kafka/RabbitMQ with outbox-published domain events.

findings.title: No adapter / anti-corruption layer for real core and payment rails
findings.description: Core is a simulated ledger with bespoke REST API.
findings.technical_impact: Replacing core requires changes in every orchestrator.
findings.remediation: Define ports/adapters (CBS, payment hub, biller) behind stable internal contracts.

findings.title: Gateway identity-propagation filter likely ineffective
findings.description: GlobalFilter calls exchange.getRequest().mutate().header(...).build() but returns the original exchange, so X-Auth-Id is not added; client-supplied X-Auth-Id passes through.
findings.remediation: Return exchange.mutate().request(mutated).build(); strip inbound X-Auth-* headers. Confirm at runtime.

findings.title: Platform duplication: Eureka + Config Server + static IPs
findings.description: Discovery and config via Spring Cloud plus static Docker IPs in config.
findings.remediation: On Kubernetes use native DNS/ConfigMaps/Secrets or Spring Cloud Kubernetes.

findings.title: Cross-cutting code duplicated in every service
findings.description: ApiRequestContext*, AppAuthUserFilter, AuditAware, BaseMapper, GlobalExceptionHandler, ErrorResponse copied per service.
findings.remediation: Shared internal starter library.

findings.title: No input validation layer
findings.description: Zero Bean Validation annotations in the codebase.
findings.remediation: Bean Validation on all request DTOs + domain invariants.

findings.title: Generic exception handler leaks internals and misuses HTTP 400
findings.description: handleException returns 'Exception occur inside API ' + e for all exceptions.
findings.technical_impact: Information disclosure; clients cannot distinguish errors.
findings.remediation: RFC 7807 ProblemDetail, correct status codes, correlation id.

findings.title: Weakly-typed controllers and reflective mapping
findings.description: Raw ResponseEntity return types; BeanUtils.copyProperties mappers instantiated with new.
findings.technical_impact: Silent field mismatches; weak API contracts.
findings.remediation: Typed responses; MapStruct mappers as beans.

findings.title: Incorrect JPA relationship on ledger row
findings.description: TransactionEntity.account mapped @OneToOne(cascade = ALL) for a many-to-one relationship.
findings.technical_impact: Cascade from transaction to account can persist/delete accounts unintentionally.
findings.remediation: @ManyToOne without cascade.

findings.title: Type mismatch for account number across services
findings.description: AccountResponse.number is Long in fund-transfer and utility-payment, String in core.
findings.remediation: Use String consistently; shared contract.

findings.title: Non-thread-safe static Keycloak client and fuzzy user search
findings.description: Static lazily-initialised Keycloak instance; users().search(email) then get(0).
findings.technical_impact: Race on init; wrong user matched for similar emails.
findings.remediation: Spring-managed singleton bean; exact email search; use created id from Location header.

findings.title: No static analysis or formatting standards
findings.description: No Checkstyle/SpotBugs/PMD/Spotless/Sonar configuration.
findings.remediation: Add Spotless + SpotBugs/Sonar gates in CI.

findings.title: Secrets committed to version control
findings.description: MySQL root/app, Keycloak admin/DB passwords, two Keycloak client secrets, test client secret, published test user password.
findings.technical_impact: Credential compromise of any default deployment.
findings.remediation: Rotate; secrets manager/K8s Secrets; gitleaks in CI; history purge if public.

findings.title: Broken object-level authorisation (OWASP API1)
findings.description: No ownership checks on transfer source, account lookup, history.
findings.remediation: Derive customer from validated JWT; entitlement checks; scoped queries.

findings.title: Broken function-level authorisation (OWASP API5)
findings.description: Status update endpoint callable by any authenticated user; no roles in realm.
findings.remediation: Realm roles + @PreAuthorize + maker-checker.

findings.title: Header-based identity trusted; internal ports published
findings.description: Services read X-Auth-Id without JWT validation; compose publishes 8083-8085, 8092, 3306 on host.
findings.remediation: Resource server per service; publish only gateway port; strip inbound auth headers.

findings.title: Plain-text password written to logs
findings.description: UserController logs request.toString(); Lombok @Data User includes password.
findings.remediation: Separate request DTO; @ToString.Exclude; log redaction policy.

findings.title: Supply chain: third-party config repo and images
findings.description: Config Server pulls from JavatoDev-com public repo; compose uses javatodev/* images.
findings.technical_impact: Third party controls routes, DB URLs and binaries.
findings.business_impact: Full compromise possible via upstream change.
findings.remediation: Org-owned private config; build/sign images in own CI; SBOM.

findings.title: No input validation (OWASP API3/API6) - security view
findings.description: Negative amounts and arbitrary fields accepted; mass-assignment via BeanUtils.copyProperties from request DTOs.
findings.remediation: Validation + explicit DTO-to-entity mapping.

findings.title: Actuator over-exposure
findings.description: Gateway and fund-transfer expose all actuator endpoints; gateway permits /actuator/** and /*/actuator/** unauthenticated.
findings.remediation: Expose health/info/prometheus only; separate management port; auth.

findings.title: Keycloak not hardened
findings.description: start-dev, HTTP, sslRequired=external, brute-force off, no password policy, direct-access grants with wildcard redirect URIs.
findings.remediation: Production mode with TLS, brute-force detection, password policy, MFA, auth-code+PKCE only, exact redirects.

findings.title: No transport encryption inside the system
findings.description: HTTP for Eureka/Config/Feign/Keycloak; JDBC URLs without TLS parameters.
findings.remediation: mTLS (mesh) or TLS per hop; MySQL sslMode=VERIFY_IDENTITY.

findings.title: No rate limiting or anti-automation
findings.description: Public register endpoint and payment endpoints unthrottled.
findings.remediation: Gateway RequestRateLimiter; CAPTCHA; velocity limits.

findings.title: Sensitive data in logs (Feign FULL, DTO toString)
findings.description: Fund-transfer Feign Logger.Level.FULL; controllers log full request DTOs.
findings.remediation: BASIC logging; masking.

findings.title: Containers run as root; mutable image tags
findings.description: Dockerfiles lack USER; compose uses tags like openzipkin/zipkin:3, postgres:15.
findings.remediation: Non-root user, read-only FS, pinned digests, image scanning.

findings.title: Dependency vulnerability status unknown
findings.description: No SCA tooling in repo; scan could not run in assessment (dependency download blocked).
findings.remediation: OWASP Dependency-Check/Trivy in CI; SBOM.

findings.title: CSRF disabled at gateway
findings.description: csrf disabled - acceptable for pure bearer-token APIs only.
findings.remediation: Document decision; enable if cookies used.

findings.title: Available balance double-adjusted
findings.description: availableBalance computed from already-updated actualBalance on debit and credit.
findings.remediation: available = available -/+ amount; explicit holds.

findings.title: Lost updates under concurrency
findings.description: Read-modify-write on BankAccountEntity without @Version or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE.
findings.remediation: Pessimistic locking ordered by account id or optimistic @Version + retry; DB CHECK constraints.

findings.title: Account status ignored in postings
findings.description: Status not checked in TransactionService.
findings.remediation: Status rules in ledger domain.

findings.title: No idempotency keys
findings.description: transactionId generated server-side per call; no unique client key.
findings.remediation: Idempotency-Key persisted with unique constraint.

findings.title: Mutable single-entry ledger without timestamps
findings.description: Balances are mutable columns; transaction rows lack timestamps, status, balance-after; transaction_id not unique.
findings.technical_impact: No auditability or replay; weak integrity.
findings.remediation: Double-entry append-only journal with posted_at/value_date and unique ids.

findings.title: Hibernate ddl-auto: update in three services
findings.description: User, fund-transfer, utility-payment schemas managed by Hibernate auto-DDL.
findings.remediation: Flyway in all services; ddl-auto validate.

findings.title: Seed data in production migration path
findings.description: V1.0.20210427174721__temp_data.sql inserts customers/accounts/billers.
findings.remediation: Move to test-only Flyway location.

findings.title: No currency, settlement or suspense accounts
findings.description: No currency column; utility payment has no credit leg.
findings.remediation: Currency + GL/settlement accounts.

findings.title: No backup, retention or data-lifecycle evidence
findings.description: No backup scripts, retention policies, or archival in repository; volumes only.
findings.remediation: Define RPO/RTO; automated backups and PITR; retention policy.

findings.title: Unbounded pagination
findings.description: Pageable endpoints without max page size.
findings.remediation: spring.data.web.pageable.max-page-size.

findings.title: No CI/CD pipeline
findings.description: Workflows removed in HEAD commit; no pipeline definitions.
findings.remediation: CI per service: build, test, SAST, SCA, secret scan, image build/scan/sign, deploy.

findings.title: No Infrastructure-as-Code or Kubernetes manifests
findings.description: Only docker-compose; README claims Kubernetes.
findings.remediation: Helm/Kustomize; Terraform for cloud resources.

findings.title: Images built from host-prebuilt JARs
findings.description: Dockerfiles ADD build/libs/*.jar; no multi-stage build.
findings.remediation: Multi-stage builds or Jib/Buildpacks in CI.

findings.title: Environment config hard-codes developer IP and static IPs
findings.description: Default bootstrap uses 192.168.1.5; external config uses 172.25.0.x.
findings.remediation: 12-factor env-var configuration; DNS names.

findings.title: Keycloak realm with secrets imported from JSON in dev mode
findings.description: Realm export with secrets mounted; start-dev --import-realm.
findings.remediation: Keycloak Operator / realm-as-code with injected secrets.

findings.title: Stateless services scale horizontally but ledger concurrency unsafe
findings.description: Services hold no session state; scaling core increases lost-update risk (TDD-DAT-02).
findings.remediation: Fix locking first, then HPA.

findings.title: N+1 calls to Keycloak when listing users
findings.description: readUsers performs one admin-API call per user.
findings.remediation: Batch fetch or cache email locally.

findings.title: No caching layer
findings.description: No cache configuration for read-heavy lookups.
findings.remediation: Caffeine/Redis with TTL for biller/account metadata.

findings.title: No asynchronous processing
findings.description: All flows synchronous request/response.
findings.remediation: Async for notifications/settlement via event bus.

findings.title: No performance test assets or NFRs
findings.description: No load tests, no SLOs.
findings.remediation: Define NFRs with stakeholders; k6/Gatling baselines.

findings.title: No timeouts, retries or circuit breakers
findings.description: No Resilience4j/Spring Cloud CircuitBreaker; Feign defaults.
findings.remediation: Resilience4j timeouts/circuit breakers; retries only for idempotent calls.

findings.title: Single instances of all stateful components
findings.description: One MySQL, one Keycloak, one Eureka, one Config Server, in-memory Zipkin.
findings.remediation: HA pairs / managed services; clustered Keycloak.

findings.title: Startup ordering via wait-for-it; no health checks
findings.description: Compose entrypoints chain wait-for-it.sh; no healthcheck stanzas.
findings.remediation: Readiness/liveness probes on actuator health groups.

findings.title: Observability limited to tracing
findings.description: Tracing 100% sampled to in-memory Zipkin; no metrics registry, structured logs or alerting.
findings.remediation: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus metrics, JSON logs with trace ids, alerting/SLOs.

findings.title: No DR / business-continuity design
findings.description: No DR documentation or automation in repository.
findings.remediation: Define RPO/RTO; multi-AZ; DR runbooks and tests.

findings.title: Minimal automated tests
findings.description: 18 unit tests in core (do not assert balances); contextLoads elsewhere; no integration/contract/E2E.
findings.remediation: Testcontainers, WireMock, contract tests, Newman/Karate E2E; JaCoCo gate.

findings.title: Seven independent builds; no version catalog
findings.description: Each service has its own wrapper and duplicated versions.
findings.remediation: Gradle multi-project + libs.versions.toml.

findings.title: No release management or versioning
findings.description: All services 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT; README releases link to upstream repo.
findings.remediation: Semantic versioning, tagged releases, changelog.

findings.title: Documentation good for learning, thin for operations
findings.description: README + tutorial links + one diagram; no ADRs, runbooks or API specs.
findings.remediation: ADRs, runbooks, published OpenAPI.

findings.title: Developer API collection out of date
findings.description: Postman paths differ from gateway routes and controller paths.
findings.remediation: Regenerate collection from OpenAPI; run in CI.

limitations: Static analysis only - services were not executed end-to-end; findings marked Medium confidence (e.g. TDD-ARC-07) should be confirmed at runtime.

`./gradlew test` with JDK 21 could not complete: Maven Central returned HTTP 429 (rate limit) during dependency resolution in the assessment environment. Test pass/fail status and dependency CVE scan are therefore not available.
Runtime configuration lives in an external, third-party repository; it was reviewed at its current HEAD, which the services do not pin.
Technology lifecycle/support statements were not re-verified online (confidence Medium).
Business data (customers, revenue, KPIs, market share, adoption, SLAs, incidents) is not in the repository and has not been estimated.
The 35-item capability reference list and effort/timeline estimates are assessor judgement, not market or benchmark data.
No UI exists; accessibility could not be assessed.
